description: This file defines a controller class for managing content detail view state in a Flutter application. It handles loading content data, caching, and playback progress recording, interacting with a content repository.

classes.name: ContentDetailsController
classes.description: A change notifier class that manages the state of content details, including loading content, handling cache updates, and recording playback progress.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads content details from the repository based on contentId, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes content data from cache; called when cache busting events occur.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Records the current playback position in seconds for the content.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks the content as playback completed.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes cache busting listener and disposes resources.
